summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-anvil2 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at npm install
details: The package's declared preinstall script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip and uses it to execute math_init.js, a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a string-array-rotation obfuscated blob (WV8StW shift decoder, hc1jfK9 character-table decoder, hex-named variables like _0x488df8) with no reachability from the package's declared React chatbot UI entry points; its only invocation is via the downloaded Bun runtime in setup.mjs (execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})). The payload's behavior is undocumented in README and CHANGELOG and is unrelated to the package's advertised UI purpose. Installing this package runs opaque, obfuscated code on the installer's host at npm install time via a non-Node runtime that evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
